messages:
tess (Marketing): Quick: we need a one-pager + 2-pg solution brief for enterprise secure deployments (VPC, on-prem, GovCloud). Use: webinar follow-up, AE handoff, and lead routing. Draft by Wed morning?
omar (Sales): Routing rules recommendation: ARR >= $250k -> AE immediate; ARR 100k-250k -> AM+SE; <100k -> PLG nurture. Any compliance tag (gov, healthcare, finance) -> force AE. Add legal-intake checkbox.
li (Product): Messaging outline: Lead with security controls, then SLA/perf guarantees, then deployment options and cost controls. One-pager must be scannable with 4 bullets max. Two-pager: include routing playbook + anonymized benchmark callouts.
meera (Security): Callouts to include: SOC2 Type II, ISO27001, support for customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, Azure KV, customer HSM), audit-log export, optional air-gapped on-prem bundle. Legal note: "BAA/DPA available  contact legal@redwood.com".
li (Product): Technical blurb for brief: "Example SLA: 99.9% monthly uptime. Latency target: p95 <200ms on Dedicated for common gen workloads. During incidents, automatic fallback to compatible variants or hosted endpoints may reduce latency guarantees."
omar (Sales): For AE handoff include a HubSpot mapping snippet and sample outreach subject: "Redwood Compliance Trial & Performance Review". Also add checkbox for "priority: legal review".
infra-bot: doc uploaded by tess: enterprise-deploy-brief-v1.docx -> https://drive.redwood.com/drive/efgh5678
tess (Marketing): I'll assemble and share the draft link. Review owners: Omar (routing), Li (product copy), Meera (security). Please comment by Tue noon. Thanks :rocket:
